rivals.name: Dex
rivals.thesis: Dex is a paid cloud CRM that syncs contacts from LinkedIn, email, calendar and messaging into one record per person. Glyph CRM keeps each person, place and organisation as a plain note in your own vault, with no account.
short: Dex has no free plan; Glyph CRM is free.
Dex keeps your contacts on its servers in the US; Glyph CRM keeps them as files in your vault.
Dex pulls people in automatically; Glyph CRM suggests new people and waits for your yes.
rivals.pick: Pick Dex if you want LinkedIn and inbox sync, Android or Windows apps, and reminders built from your real message history.

price: No free plan. Premium $12 a month billed yearly, $20 monthly. 7-day trial
platforms: Web, iOS, Android, Mac, Windows, Chrome extension
input: Syncs LinkedIn, email, calendar, WhatsApp and 15+ other sources
storage: Dex's servers on Google Cloud, processed in the US
export: CSV of contacts, notes and LinkedIn updates

rivals.name: Mesh
rivals.thesis: Mesh, formerly Clay, is a cloud contact app that gathers people from your email, calendar and social accounts and keeps their details current. Glyph CRM keeps people as plain notes in your own vault and adds no one without your yes.
short: Mesh is free up to 1,000 contacts with a card on file; Glyph CRM is free with no account.
Mesh fills itself from your accounts; Glyph CRM suggests people and you decide.
Mesh keeps data on its servers; Glyph CRM keeps it as files you own.
rivals.pick: Pick Mesh if you want contacts filled in and kept current for you from email, calendar and social accounts, on Windows and Android too.

price: Free up to 1,000 contacts, card required. Pro $10 a month billed yearly
account: Yes, with a card on file even for the free plan
input: Syncs email, calendar, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, iMessage
storage: Mesh's servers, encrypted at rest; location not given

rivals.note: Clay was renamed Mesh: clay.earth now redirects to me.sh, and the site no longer uses the Clay name.

rivals.name: Folk
rivals.thesis: Folk is a paid cloud CRM for teams, filled from a Chrome extension, email and calendar sync and CSV imports. Glyph CRM is a free personal CRM that keeps each page as a plain note in your own vault.
short: Folk starts at $24 a user a month; Glyph CRM is free.
Folk is built for teams and sales; Glyph CRM is for one person's life.
Folk stores data on AWS in Ireland; Glyph CRM stores it in your vault.
rivals.pick: Pick Folk if a team shares the contacts, or you need pipelines, email sequences and a REST API.

price: Standard $24 a user a month billed yearly, Premium $48. 14-day trial
platforms: Web, iOS, Android, desktop app, Chrome extension
account: Yes, blocked after the trial unless you pay
input: Chrome extension, Gmail and Outlook sync, CSV import, card scans
export: CSV of any view; API on Premium

rivals.name: Monica
rivals.alt_title: A free, private Monica alternative with native apps
rivals.thesis: Monica is an open source personal CRM that runs in a browser, on your own server or on its paid hosted service. Glyph CRM is a native Mac and iPhone app that keeps people as plain notes in your own vault, with notes by voice.
short: Monica is free to self-host and $9 a month hosted; Glyph CRM is free.
Monica runs in a browser; Glyph CRM is a native Mac and iPhone app.
Monica's source is open (AGPL-3.0); Glyph CRM's is private.
rivals.pick: Pick Monica if you want open source code you can read and change, and you are happy to run your own server.

price: Free to self-host. Hosted $9 a month or $90 a year
platforms: Web app, also in a phone browser. Native apps planned
account: Hosted needs one, and new sign-ups are closed. Self-hosted: none with Monica
storage: Your own server, or Laravel Cloud when hosted
export: Export all your data at any time

rivals.note: As of November 2026 the pricing page says registration for the hosted version is closed.
